title: French and Francophone Studies, B.S. -- Applied French Option (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Applied French Option (of three: French-Business, French-Engineering, Applied French -- French-Engineering requires a mandatory one-semester engineering internship in France the schema can't model, French-Business needs Smeal-specific ACCTG/BA/IB courses; Applied French chosen since its 'related areas' requirement is explicitly generic and adviser-driven, and it has the only fully detailed sample semester schedule). Sibling of the already-built French B.A. (FRENCHBA-2026.json), reusing fr_catalog.json. Added 5 missing courses to fr_catalog.json with real prereqs confirmed via direct DOM inspection of the department's own course-description page: FR 401 (needs FR 201 AND FR 202), FR 409 (needs FR 201 OR FR 202), FR 417 (needs FR 201 AND FR 202), FR 418 (needs FR 201 AND FR 202), FR 419 (needs FR 316). Real difference from the B.A.: same FR 1/2/3 (uncoded) -> FR 201/202 -> 401/402Y/316/331-352 pipeline, plus an 18cr 'related areas' Applied Option (in consultation with adviser, min 6cr at 400-level) and a separate 6cr '400-level French' requirement -- both modeled as generic slots, same convention as the B.A.'s own '4xx-level FR Course' pool and Political Science's 'Related course in consultation with adviser'. Computed 8-semester total (123cr) matches the bulletin's own stated total exactly. RE-VERIFIED against the live bulletin (2026-08): the Common Requirements section (shared by all French options, B.A. and B.S. alike) lists the linguistics pick as 'Select one: FR 316, FR 417, FR 418, or FR 419' (3cr), but Semester 5's 'FR 316' was hardcoded as the sole option -- fixed to a 4-way pool, matching the exact same real bug found and fixed in the sibling FRENCHBA-2026.json.
